exercises.name: Pull Up (Band)

source_english.description: Pull Up (Band) pulls from a controlled hang until the chin reaches or clears the bar, then lowers under control.
instructions: Attach the band to a pull-up bar or sturdy anchor point.
Step onto the band and grip the bar with your palms facing away from you, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Hang with your arms fully extended, keeping your core engaged and your shoulders down and back.
Pull your body up towards the bar by squeezing your shoulder blades together and driving your elbows down towards your hips.
Continue pulling until your chin is above the bar, then slowly lower yourself back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
form_cues: Keep the ribs stacked and shoulders down.
Drive the elbows toward the torso.
Control the return to the start.
common_mistakes: Leaning or swinging to move the load.
source_english.safety_note: Use a secure station and a load or assistance level you can control through the full range.

exercises.name: Ring Push Up

source_english.description: A ring push-up lowers the chest between freely moving rings and presses back to a stabilized high plank.
instructions: Set the rings just above the floor and grip them in a stable neutral position.
Step back into a high plank with the body straight and feet set wide.
Lower the chest between the rings while keeping the elbows angled back.
Press through the rings to return to the plank and stabilize before repeating.
form_cues: Keep the rings close to the body.
source_english.safety_note: Set the rings low and use a range you can control without the shoulders losing stability.

exercises.name: Scapular Pull Ups

source_english.description: Hang from a pull-up bar and depress the shoulder blades with straight elbows before relaxing back to the hang.
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with palms facing away and elbows straight.
Without bending the elbows, pull the shoulder blades down and slightly together.
Pause with the body lifted only by the scapular movement.
Release the shoulder blades slowly to return to the relaxed hang.

source_english.safety_note: Use a secure setup and stop if alignment or control is lost.

exercises.name: Squat (Suspension)

instructions: Hold the suspension handles and stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Brace the trunk and sit the hips back while bending both knees.

Press through the feet to stand without pulling yourself forward.
form_cues: Use the straps for balance, not a row.
source_english.safety_note: Anchor the suspension trainer securely and keep the handles at a height you can control.

scene.pose: Arms stay straight, legs together and straight; abdomen raises legs until toes contact bar, with controlled pelvis and no swing.
scene.grip: Overhand grip on secure pull-up bar.
scene.supports_and_equipment: Hands and toes contact the same fixed overhead bar at this endpoint; no floor support.

source_instruction_quotes.text: Grip a secure pull-up bar overhand with arms straight and legs hanging together.
Brace the abdomen and raise the straight legs toward the bar without swinging.
Continue until the toes touch the bar between the hands.
Lower the legs slowly to the dead hang and reset.

exercises.name: Triceps Dip

source_english.description: Triceps Dip is a bodyweight parallel-bar dip: support on straight arms, lower by bending the elbows, and press back up.
instructions: Grip parallel bars and support the body with elbows straight and shoulders down.
Keep the torso slightly forward and bend the elbows to lower the body.
Stop when the upper arms approach parallel to the floor without the shoulders collapsing.
Press through the bars to straighten the elbows and return to support.
source_english.safety_note: Use parallel bars or an assisted band, and stop before the shoulders lose stable support.

exercises.name: Triceps Dip (Weighted)

source_english.description: Triceps Dip (Weighted) adds a belt or vest load to a strict parallel-bar dip.
instructions: Secure the added load and grip parallel bars with elbows straight.
Lower the body by bending the elbows while keeping the torso slightly forward.
Pause when the upper arms approach parallel without shoulder collapse.
Press to straight arms and step down only after the swing has stopped.
source_english.safety_note: Use a conservative belt or vest load and stop before the shoulders lose control.
